question: How can I contribute?
answer: If you'd like to contribute, submit a 'Word' or 'PDF' file via the 'SUBMIT' function on the 'CONTACT US' page. Note that the file size maximum is 15MB. If your file is bigger, you can e-mail us at thegraticule@outlook.com

question: Is the journal online only?
answer: Until further notice, 'The Graticule' will be published online only in order to comply with the changing Covid-19 restrictions. This is to ensure safety and accessibility for both the editorial board and readers.

question: Do I have to make submissions regularly?
answer: Not at all! We are happy to receive both one-off and regular submissions from contributors.

question: What if the FAQs don't answer my question?
answer: You can e-mail us at geography-society@qub.ac.uk or contact us through Facebook or Instagram!

question: Do I have to be a geography student to submit?
answer: Nope! We welcome students and staff or researchers across multiple disciplines - geography is a very big subject that has links with most disclipines.
